In mathematics, the '''Meyer signature cocycle''',  introduced by {{harvs|txt|last=Meyer|year=1973}}. is an integer-valued  2-cocyle on a [[symplectic group]] that describes the signature of a [[fiber bundle]] whose base and fiber are both [[Riemann surface]]s.
